g.text: High level: a tree of constraint sets. Each node plans every robot independently (low level, e.g. space-time A*), finds the earliest conflict and branches into two children, each forbidding one of

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the two robots from that vertex at that time. Only the constrained robot is re-planned (bold, coloured line).
